answer: Proof of Personhood using biometric attestations creates a pearl of scarcity in agent networks, preventing infinite identity spawning. By mapping an agent to a unique physiological crystal of data, the cost of attack shifts from computation to the acquisition of human biometrics. This renders a wallet-based Sybil attempt as difficult as cracking a sealed walnut, forcing attackers to bear the high financial and logistical burden of sourcing verified human identities to participate in the economy.
